/* ========================================= Hexo-blog-encrypt 密码框样式完全重置 ========================================= */ /* 1. 清除容器本身的边框和阴影 */ .hbe-container, #hexo-blog-encrypt, .hbe-input-container { border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; outline: none !important; background: transparent !important; border-radius: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; } /* 2. 清除所有伪元素（::before 和 ::after）*/ .hbe-container::before, .hbe-container::after, #hexo-blog-encrypt::before, #hexo-blog-encrypt::after, .hbe-input-container::before, .hbe-input-container::after, .hbe-container *::before, .hbe-container *::after { display: none !important; content: none !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; background: none !important; } /* 3. 密码输入框样式 */ .hbe-input-container input, #hexo-blog-encrypt input[type="password"], #hexo-blog-encrypt input[type="text"] { border-radius: 8px !important; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0 !important; padding: 10px 15px !important; background-color: #ffffff !important; color: #333333 !important; outline: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; transition: border-color 0.3s ease !important; width: 100% !important; box-sizing: border-box !important; -webkit-appearance: none !important; /* 清除浏览器默认样式 */ -moz-appearance: none !important; appearance: none !important; } /* 输入框聚焦时的效果 */ .hbe-input-container input:focus, #hexo-blog-encrypt input[type="password"]:focus { border-color: #ff6b6b !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.2) !important; outline: none !important; } /* 4. 解密按钮样式 */ .hbe-button, #hexo-blog-encrypt button, #hexo-blog-encrypt input[type="submit"] { border-radius: 8px !important; background-color: #ff6b6b !important; color: #ffffff !important; border: none !important; padding: 10px 20px !important; cursor: pointer !important; font-weight: bold !important; transition: all 0.3s ease !important; margin-top: 10px !important; box-shadow: none !important; outline: none !important; -webkit-appearance: none !important; -moz-appearance: none !important; appearance: none !important; } /* 按钮鼠标悬停效果 */ .hbe-button:hover, #hexo-blog-encrypt button:hover, #hexo-blog-encrypt input[type="submit"]:hover { background-color: #ff4c4c !important; transform: translateY(-1px) !important; box-shadow: none !important; } /* 5. 提示文字样式 */ .hbe-container p, #hexo-blog-encrypt p, .hbe-container .hbe-abstract { color: #666666 !important; font-size: 14px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; margin-bottom: 15px !important; } /* ========================================= Hexo-blog-encrypt 分类封面背景样式 ========================================= */ /* 当分类封面不存在时，使用渐变背景代替默认纯色 */ .nexmoe-category .nexmoe-cover, .nexmoe-category-list .nexmoe-card::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%) !important; background-size: cover !important; } /* 或者使用随机图片API作为备用 */ .nexmoe-category .nexmoe-cover.no-cover { background-image: url('https://uapis.cn/api/v1/random/image') !important; background-size: cover !important; background-position: center !important; }
